title: Security certification timeline, SSO/SAML & audit-logs deliverable tracking
creator: Priya Singh
description: Consolidate milestone-level tracking for our 2025 compliance work: SOC2 Type II readiness, ISO27001 gap closure, SSO/SAML integration, and structured audit-log delivery. The goal is a single source of truth that ties milestones to engineering tickets, documentation artifacts, control owners, and customer-facing commitments. This ticket establishes deliverables, critical path, and cadence for PM + Eng + Security syncs and will be the parent for individual feature milestones and rollout plans.
milestones: M1: SSO/SAML core implementation complete — owner: ENG-Security (ENG-4122) — due: 2025-03-20 — status: In Review
M2: Audit-log schema stable & export pipeline — owner: Observability (ENG-4188) — due: 2025-03-28 — status: In Progress
M3: SOC2 PoA controls mapped & evidence collection started — owner: Compliance (PM-7610) — due: 2025-04-01 — status: Planned
M4: ISO27001 gap remediation plan published — owner: Security (PM-7625) — due: 2025-04-08 — status: Planned
M5: External readiness review & pre-audit checklist complete — owner: Priya Singh — due: 2025-04-15 — status: Planned
acceptance_criteria: SSO/SAML: SAML metadata upload, IdP-triggered login, and successful role mapping in a test VPC
Audit-logs: Lineage, immutability guarantees documented, and daily export to secure S3 with retention policy
SOC2: Control owners assigned for infra, change management, and incident response with evidence documented in Confluence
ISO: Risk register updated and top-10 gaps assigned owners with remediation ETA
risks: Delay in ENG-4122 could push SSO rollout past customer contract dates
Audit pipeline relies on a 3rd-party logging agent that has an unresolved bug
Resource contention between Dedicated capacity work and compliance remediation could reduce bandwidth
mitigations: Prioritize a focused "minimal SAML" flow that covers enterprise customers for initial release
Work with vendor on hotfix and prepare fallback of agentless export for short-term needs
Negotiate 2-week protected sprint window with infra to unblock compliance-critical tickets
stakeholders: Ava Chen — Engineering Manager, Security Services
